title: Purely Optimization
body:
# **Purely Optimization: Your Game Optimized**
## Performance
Purely Optimization **focuses on delivering top-tier performance with the help of modern Fabric-based mods** like Sodium, Lithium, and others. Each bundled mod is carefully selected to ensure **stability, safety, and significant FPS improvements** on a wide range of devices, making your Minecraft experience **smoother** than ever.

## Compatibility
Enjoy **support for many OptiFine-like features**, such as shaders, connected textures, and zoom. Resource packs labeled "OptiFine required" are likely to work seamlessly, **allowing you to enhance your visuals without losing performance.**

##  Gameplay
Purely Optimization ensures you experience Minecraft the way you remember, no matter your preferred version. **Play with controllers, shaders, resoure packs and more.**

## Play Anywhere
**This modpack is purely focused on optimization** and does **not include** any content mods, meaning you can explore **any world or server "without restrictions"**. Whether you're building in single-player or adventuring on multiplayer servers, Purely Optimization **is the perfect choice.**

## Always Up-to-Date
**Built for Minecraft version 1.21.4**, Purely Optimization is designed to stay current, with **quick updates** to bring you the latest performance improvements as new Minecraft versions are released.


## Powered by Fabric
**Purely Optimization runs on the lightweight and efficient Fabric mod loader**, allowing for unparalleled performance and customization. **You can use this modpack as-is or as a foundation to add your favorite mods.**
